violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the hood filters had accumulation of dust at the cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. ENSURE HOOD FILTERS ARE CLEANED BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Toilet Room, Kept Closed
violations.observation: Observed that employee toilet room door is being kept open.
violations.corrective_action: Keep toilet room doors closed to prevent insect and rodent entrance and the associated spread of potential disease. CDI: RESTROOM DOOR WAS CLOSED DURING THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: a package of raw eggs was stored over onions and oranges in the walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. The PIC moved the raw eggs during the inspection. CDI.
